description: Grant or revoke ONE reviewer feedback grant (absolute-state). Grants require the target to hold an ACTIVE contract on the job; revokes are idempotent no-ops when absent. Historical reports and events are never touched. Receipt-backed. Requires job_feedback:write.

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_job_feedback_access_set
